_comment: Eight skills. attr = governing attribute. Class skills cost 1 point per rank, cross-class 2. Rank limits: class = level+3, cross-class = floor((level+3)/2). See progression.json.

computer_use.name: Computer Use
computer_use.desc: Slice terminals, override doors, manipulate ship security and launch systems.
computer_use.uses: Checkpoint override, turret shutdown, archive index, plate grid, crane console, launch override

demolitions.name: Demolitions
demolitions.desc: Disarm, recover and place mines; craft explosives.
demolitions.uses: Disarm and recover the checkpoint mine, archive mines, craft grenades and mines

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.desc: Move unseen. Opposed by enemy Awareness, distance and line of sight. Attacking from stealth deals sneak attack damage.
stealth.uses: Crawlway sentry, archive catwalk bypass, sneak attacks

awareness.name: Awareness
awareness.desc: Notice hidden hazards, mines, clues and people. Also used by enemies to detect you.
awareness.uses: Mines, live plates, hidden scout, wreckage clues

persuasion.name: Persuasion
persuasion.desc: Convince, deceive or intimidate in conversation.
persuasion.uses: Steward, Iona, wounded passengers, Senna, reclaimers, Commander Varr, Marshal Quill

repair.name: Repair
repair.desc: Restore machines, fix damaged systems and improve repair kits used on synthetics.
repair.uses: Vent grate, purge valve, coolant pumps, steam valves, bay turrets, Tav-7 field repairs

security.name: Security
security.uses: Blast door, armory locker, footlockers, maintenance hatch

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.desc: Treat injuries, stabilize the wounded and improve medpacs used on organics.
medicine.uses: Triage ward, sealed ward survivors, Senna's wound, medical fabrication, medpac potency
